Annotation Interface ProxyPort

@Documented @Retention(SOURCE) @Target(TYPE_USE) public @interface ProxyPort
Indicates that the field that follows represents a SysML "proxy" port. The field variable should be an instance of an extension class of the SysMLProxyPort and should be created/initialized in the createProxyPorts() method.
